//: Crawler + scoring service. Deploy this repo as a Railway service sharing the tender-intelligence app's DATABASE_URL. The `serve` role runs the full cycle every CRAWL_INTERVAL_HOURS (12) and serves POST /crawl, which is what the app's dashboard button calls -- so set CRAWLER_TRIGGER_TOKEN here and to the same value in the app, and point the app's CRAWLER_URL at this service's *private* domain (http://<service>.railway.internal:8080). It needs no public domain: only the app calls it. Set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY to enable the assessment stage; without it the cycle still crawls and heuristically scores.

deploy.//: ALWAYS, unlike the batch roles: this one is a server, so an exit is a fault and should be restarted. The single-slot guard lives in the process, so keep this at one replica -- two would each schedule their own cycle.
